articles.title: Frankreich: Polizei verhindert mutmaßlichen Anschlag auf US-Bank in Paris
articles.teaser: Die Pariser Polizei hat in der Nacht einen Mann festgenommen, der offenbar Sprengstoff vor einer US-Bank abgelegt hatte. Die Anti-Terror-Staatsanwaltschaft ermittelt.
articles.image_title: Frankreich: Police officials stand alongside police and private security vehicles outside The Bank of America building in the 8th arrondissement of Paris on March 28, 2026, following an apparent bomb attack attempt. French police stopped an apparent bomb attack outside a US bank in Paris early March 28, 2026, when they arrested a man about to set off a homemade explosive device, sources close to the case told AFP. The incident occurred around 3:30 am (0130 GMT) in front of a Bank of America building in the chic 8th arrondissement, a couple of streets from the Champs-Elysees. (Photo by Sebastien DUPUY / AFP via Getty Images)

Today's protest follows charges brought by actress Collien Fernandes against her husband, actor Christian Ulmen, over several accusations, including her claim that he shared deepfake sexual videos of her online. Fernandes is calling for better legislation in Germany to protect women against online sexual attacks. Fernandes filed the charges in Spain, where she says the law better protects women in online cases than in Germany.

articles.image_title: Frauenfeindlichkeit: Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan Tate talk to the media outside their residence on March 23, 2025 in Bucharest, Romania. Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan had flown to the United States last month from Romania, where they have been charged with rape, having sex with a minor, human trafficking and money laundering, charges which they deny. Their bail conditions stipulated that they had to return to Romania by March 23.
